capabilities: Start Obsidian hidden at Windows login
Hide the window and pop-outs to the system tray on close
Restore the running window instead of the vault picker
Open today's quick note from a global hotkey or tray menu
Relaunch or fully quit Obsidian from the tray menu
extras: Verified on Windows only and inactive elsewhere; the interface is in Chinese. The README advises turning off other tray plugins first because their hotkeys and close behavior conflict. No network connections or telemetry; it writes a Windows login item only when autostart is enabled. Installable through BRAT.
problem: Obsidian quits when the close button is pressed and shows the vault picker on every launch, so it cannot stay quietly available in the background.
